name: Terminal
description: A terminal window with a prompt, a command and its output; can type the command out and then reveal the output line by line.

params.name: prompt
params.help: Prompt before the command, e.g. $ or ~/app $

params.name: output
params.help: Output lines (about 12 fit; the last lines stay visible). Lines starting with error or warning are coloured

params.name: typing
params.help: Type the command out, then reveal the output line by line (restarts when the command or output changes)
